name: Bigin CRM Integration
description: Pushes new Drupal user accounts into Zoho Bigin CRM as contacts and deals via the Bigin REST API (OAuth2).
project_description:
The main purpouse of this module is add all your Drupal new users accounts like prospects in Bigin CRM , the new kid on the block of Zoho familiy. Uses the Bigin Rest APIs to provide integration.

 Instructions 

 
 Download and enable Bigin CRM integration module to your Drupal site. 
 Register your application (client) with Bigin's Authorization server https://api-console.zoho.com/ 
 Navigate to Admin > Configuration > Bigin and fill all fields form with your application data. 
 Get authorization by clicking on the button Get access token . 
 After getting an authorization go to Bigin Settings and fill all fields with pipelines data. 
 
 Features 
 Creates all new Drupal verified accounts like prospects. More features added in next months.

 Currently is a work in progress.
